title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Daniel 6: the plot against Daniel and the night in the lions' den.

questions.text: Who was king when Daniel was thrown into the lions' den?
questions.explanation: Darius the Mede ruled the kingdom and set 120 satraps over it, with Daniel as one of three presidents.

answers.text: Nebuchadnezzar
Belshazzar
Cyrus
Darius

questions.text: Why did the other officials want to bring Daniel down?
questions.explanation: Daniel distinguished himself with an excellent spirit, and the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom.

answers.text: He had been caught stealing from the royal treasury
He had refused to pay the taxes of the kingdom
The king planned to promote him above them all
He had spoken against the king in public

questions.text: What did the decree forbid for thirty days?
questions.explanation: No one could ask a petition of any god or man except the king, or be thrown into the den of lions.

answers.text: Eating meat or drinking wine at the feast
Praying to anyone except the king
Traveling outside the city of Babylon
Selling grain to the foreign merchants

questions.text: What did Daniel do when he heard the decree was signed?
questions.explanation: He went to his house, opened his windows toward Jerusalem and prayed, as he always had.

answers.text: He went home and prayed as before
He hid himself away inside the palace
He fled from the city that night
He begged the king to cancel the decree

questions.text: How often did Daniel pray each day?
questions.explanation: Daniel knelt on his knees three times a day, praying and giving thanks before his God.

answers.text: Only once, at the break of day
Twice, at morning and evening
Three times
Seven times, through the whole day

questions.text: Which way did the windows of Daniel's room face?
questions.explanation: Daniel's windows were open toward Jerusalem.

answers.text: Toward Babylon
Toward Jerusalem
Toward the sunrise
Toward the palace

questions.text: How did the king feel when he heard what the officials reported?
questions.explanation: The king was very displeased and worked until sundown to rescue Daniel.

answers.text: He was glad and rewarded the officials
He was angry at Daniel for disobeying
He felt nothing and went to sleep
He was displeased and tried to save Daniel

questions.text: How was the den of lions closed?
questions.explanation: A stone was brought and laid on the mouth of the den, and the king sealed it with his own signet ring.

answers.text: A stone sealed with the king's signet
An iron gate locked with a key
Heavy beams nailed across
A guard stood in front

questions.text: What did Daniel say had shut the lions' mouths?
questions.explanation: Daniel said his God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths, because he was found innocent before him.

answers.text: The lions were already fed
The king's decree
God sent his angel
Daniel's skill with animals

questions.text: What happened to the men who had accused Daniel?
questions.explanation: The king commanded that those who had accused Daniel be thrown into the den of lions, with their children and wives.

answers.text: They were sent into exile
They were thrown into the lions' den
They were fined
They were made servants
